style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;display:inline-table;margin-bottom:5pt;vertical-align:text-bottom;width:100.000%"><tr><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:28.387%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td><td style="width:0.441%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td><td style="width:1.0%"></td><td style="width:68.772%"></td><td style="width:0.1%"></td></tr><tr style="height:17pt"><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td></tr><tr><td colspan="3" style="padding:1.5pt 1pt 1.5pt 10pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:top"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9.5pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Goldman Sachs Investment</font></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:0 1pt"></td><td colspan="3" style="padding:1.5pt 1pt;text-align:left;vertical-align:top"><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;padding-right:2.77pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:9.5pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Following the date on which the vote of the Unitholders to remove the Investment Manager becomes effective, Goldman Sachs, any Employee Fund and &#47; or any Affiliated Unitholders (a) will be under no obligation to invest concurrently with or into any Partnership Investments, (b) may require a repurchase (in whole or in part) of their Units and (c) may, at their option, Transfer their respective Units to a third party, including to Affiliates of the Successor Investment Manager.</font></div></td></tr></table></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit B-4</font></div></div></div><div id="i80e0f31fc0a942af8545b80281a09983_19"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Exhibit C</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Distribution Reinvestment Plan</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">This Distribution Reinvestment Plan (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%;text-decoration:underline">DRIP</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221;) has been adopted by G-Private Equity LP (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%;text-decoration:underline">Partnership</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221;).  Unless otherwise defined herein, capitalized terms shall have the same meaning as set forth in its Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership (as amended, restated or otherwise modified from time to time, the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%;text-decoration:underline">Partnership Agreement</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221;).</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:7pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">1.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Distribution Reinvestment</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  As agent for the Unitholders who elect to participate in the DRIP or who are automatically enrolled pursuant to the terms of a subscription for Units (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%;text-decoration:underline">Participants</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221;), the General Partner (as delegated to the Investment Manager) will apply all cash distributions made in respect of the Units held by each Participant (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:116%;text-decoration:underline">Distributions</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221;), to the purchase of additional Units of the same Class for such Participant.  For the avoidance of doubt, the holders of Class A Units will not be automatically enrolled, or permitted to elect to participate, in the DRIP in respect of such Class A Units, and the terms of the DRIP set forth herein will not apply to cash distributions made to the holders of Class A Units.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">2.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Effective Date</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">. The effective date of this DRIP shall be the date of the First Closing of the Partnership.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">3.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Procedure for Participation</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  Any Unitholder may elect to become a Participant by completing and executing a Subscription Agreement for Units (which shall provide for automatic enrollment unless such Unitholder opts out), an enrollment form or any appropriate authorization form as may be available from the Partnership.  Participation in the DRIP will begin with the next Distribution made after acceptance of a Participant&#8217;s subscription, enrollment or authorization (subject to the notice period for changes described below).  Units will be purchased under the DRIP as of the Subscription Date occurring on or immediately following the effective date of the applicable Distribution (notwithstanding that payments in respect of distributions that are not reinvested pursuant to the DRIP may be made later).  Participants must provide at least 10 Business Days&#8217; prior written notice to the General Partner of any change to their participation in the DRIP.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">4.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Suitability</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  Upon each reinvestment, each Participant shall automatically be deemed to have reaffirmed, restated and re-acknowledged the agreements, acknowledgments, representations, warranties and other obligations set forth in such Participant&#8217;s Subscription Booklet.  Each Participant agrees that if such Participant at any time fails to meet the then-current suitability requirements for making an investment in the Partnership or cannot make the other representations or warranties as set forth in the Partnership&#8217;s most recent applicable Offering Memorandum or Subscription Agreement, enrollment form or other authorization form, such Participant will promptly so notify the Partnership in writing.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">5.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Purchase of Units</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  Under the DRIP, distributions in respect of Units are reinvested in Units of the same Class as of the Subscription Date occurring on or immediately following the effective date of the applicable Distribution for a purchase price equal to the NAV per Unit of such Class as of such Subscription Date (determined in the same manner as subscriptions).  No interest shall be paid on cash distributions pending reinvestment under the terms of the DRIP.  Participants in the DRIP may purchase fractional Units to one thousandth of a Unit so that 100% of the Distributions will be used to acquire Units (subject to any rounding to one thousandth of a Unit).  However, a Participant will not be able to acquire DRIP Units and such Participant&#8217;s participation in the DRIP will be terminated to the extent that a reinvestment of such Participant&#8217;s Distributions in Units would cause the percentage ownership or other limitations contained in the Partnership Agreement or the Offering Memorandum to be violated.  Units issued pursuant to the DRIP shall not be subject to the Early Exit Fee.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">6.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Taxes</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  THE REINVESTMENT OF DISTRIBUTIONS DOES NOT RELIEVE A PARTICIPANT OF ANY INCOME TAX LIABILITY THAT MAY BE PAYABLE ON INCOME ALLOCATED TO THE PARTICIPANT IN RESPECT OF ITS UNITS.  EACH UNITHOLDER OF THE PARTNERSHIP WILL BE </font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit C-1</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">REQUIRED TO REPORT ON ITS U.S. FEDERAL INCOME TAX RETURN, AND WILL BE TAXED UPON, ITS ALLOCABLE SHARE OF EACH ITEM OF THE PARTNERSHIP&#8217;S INCOME, GAIN, LOSS, DEDUCTION AND CREDIT FOR EACH TAXABLE YEAR OF THE PARTNERSHIP ENDING WITH OR WITHIN THE UNITHOLDER&#8217;S TAXABLE YEAR.  UNITHOLDERS MUST REPORT THESE ITEMS REGARDLESS OF THE EXTENT TO WHICH, OR WHETHER, THEY RECEIVE AND &#47; OR REINVEST CASH DISTRIBUTIONS FROM THE PARTNERSHIP FOR SUCH TAXABLE YEAR.  INFORMATION REGARDING POTENTIAL TAX INCOME LIABILITY OF PARTICIPANTS MAY BE FOUND IN SECTION V&#58; &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">RISKS AND POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST&#8212;NAV ACCRUALS AND UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">&#8221; OF THE OFFERING MEMORANDUM.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">7.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Reports</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  On a monthly basis, to the extent a distribution was made during such month, the Partnership shall provide each Participant a statement of account, which will include a description, as to such Participant, of&#58; (i) the distributions reinvested during the month&#59; (ii) the number and Class of Units purchased pursuant to the DRIP during the month&#59; (iii) the per-Unit purchase price for such Units&#59; and (iv) the total number of Units purchased on behalf of the Participant under the DRIP.  On an annual basis, tax information with respect to income earned on Units under the DRIP for the calendar year will be provided to each applicable participant.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">8.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Termination by Participant</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  A Participant may terminate participation in the DRIP at any time, without penalty, by delivering at least 10 Business Days&#8217; prior written notice to the Partnership.  This notice must be received by the Partnership at least 10 Business Days prior to the effective date of a Distribution in order for a Participant&#8217;s termination to be effective for such Distribution.  Any transfer of Units by a Participant to a non-Participant will terminate participation in the DRIP with respect to the transferred Units.  Upon termination of DRIP participation for any reason, future distributions will be distributed to the Unitholder in cash.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">9.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Amendment, Suspension or Termination by the Partnership</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  The General Partner, in consultation with the Investment Manager, may amend, modify, revise or restate any aspect of the DRIP from time to time and any such amendment shall not be considered a material adverse change to the rights and obligations of the Unitholders&#59; provided that the DRIP cannot be amended to eliminate a Participant&#8217;s right to terminate participation in the DRIP and that notice of any material amendment must be provided to Participants at least 10 Business Days&#8217; prior to the effective date of that amendment.  The General Partner, in consultation with the Investment Manager, may suspend or terminate the DRIP for any reason at any time.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:justify"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">10.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:116%">Liability of the Partnership</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:116%">.  None of the Partnership, the General Partner or the Investment Manager shall be liable for any act done in good faith, or for any good faith omission to act, including, without limitation, any claims or liability with respect to the time and the prices at which Units are purchased or sold for a Participant&#8217;s account.</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit C-2</font></div></div></div><div id="i80e0f31fc0a942af8545b80281a09983_22"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Exhibit D</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">1.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Definitions</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.  Capitalized terms not otherwise defined shall have the meanings given to them in the Amended and Restated Agreement of Limited Partnership of G-Private Equity LP (the &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Onshore LPA</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221;).  For the purposes of this Exhibit&#58;</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Disparity</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; shall mean the amount of the difference between a Class&#8217;s Adjusted Class Account and Adjusted Tax Basis.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Disparity Items</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; shall mean the Partnership&#8217;s items of income, gain and loss that Investment Managers, as delegated by the General Partner, determine (in their reasonable discretion and in consultation with the Partnership&#8217;s tax advisors) contribute to the Disparity as listed on Appendix A, as may be amended from time to time in the reasonable discretion of the Investment Manager as delegated by the General Partner, in consultation with the Partnership&#8217;s tax advisors.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">NAV Adjustment Items</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; shall mean any items other than Disparity Items (e.g., NAV Adjustment Items are expected to include management fees, fund level expenses, carried interest, bank interest payments, and other items, that, as determined in the discretion of the Investment Managers, do not impact the Disparity in respect of a Class).</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Residual Items</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; shall mean that portion of each Disparity Item that remains to be allocated at the moment that every Class&#8217;s Disparity has been reduced to zero.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">2.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Capital Accounts</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.  The General Partner does not intend to maintain capital accounts under 704(b) and the Treasury Regulations thereunder.  The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) intends to rely on the &#8220;partner&#8217;s interest in the partnership&#8221; rules under the Code and applicable Treasury Regulations for purposes of allocating items of Partnership income, gain and loss.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:18pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">3.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">NAV Adjustment Items, Adjusted NAV Account and Adjusted Tax Basis</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.  All NAV Adjustment Items shall be allocated among the Classes in a manner identical or similar to the manner in which such items were treated for purposes of determining the Class Account of each Class.  The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) shall establish and maintain for each Class an &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted NAV Account</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; equal to the cumulative NAV Adjustment Items allocated to such Class as of a given date as described in clause 4(c) below&#59; provided, however, that to the extent Units of a Class have been redeemed, the Adjusted NAV Account of such Class shall be reduced by a portion of the cumulative NAV Adjustment Items so allocated as of the date of redemption corresponding to the percentage of the Class Account of such Class redeemed as of such date.  The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) shall also determine an &#8220;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Adjusted Tax Basis</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">&#8221; for each Class which shall be equal to the cumulative Disparity Items allocated to such Class pursuant to paragraphs 4(a) and (b) below&#59; provided, however, that to the extent Units of a Class have been redeemed, the Adjusted Tax Basis of such Class shall be reduced by that portion of the cumulative Disparity Items so allocated as of the date of redemption corresponding to the percentage of the Class Account of such Class redeemed as of such date. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">4.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Allocations for Tax Purposes</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">a.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Disparity Items shall be allocated among the Classes pro rata based on the Disparity in respect of each such Class, until such time as the Disparity in respect of each Class has been reduced to zero (but not below).</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">b.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Residual Items shall be allocated in proportion to the direct or indirect net contributions to the Partnership made in respect of each Class.  Tax items corresponding or similar to NAV Adjustment Items shall be allocated in the same or a similar manner to the manner in which they were treated for purposes of determining the Class Account of each Class.</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit D-1</font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">c.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;Other items shall be allocated pro rata to each Class&#8217;s change in Adjusted NAV Account for the relevant year.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">d.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; Any amounts allocated to a Class shall be further allocated to each Sub-Account of such Class on a pro rata basis or otherwise as determined by the General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) in its discretion. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">e.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) may, in its discretion, allocate items of gross or net income and&#47;or gross or net deduction to the extent it deems appropriate to achieve the desired allocations consistent with the foregoing or to the extent required by law.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">f.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) shall allocate the income and loss of the Partnership for applicable tax purposes in a manner so as to give economic effect, to the maximum extent possible, to the economic entitlements and allocations set forth in the Onshore LPA and the Private Placement Memorandum, and in accordance with applicable tax principles. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">g.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;For any item otherwise to be allocated pursuant to this clause 4 that is not determinable or, in the General Partner&#8217;s (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager&#8217;s) reasonable discretion, should not be determined, on a monthly basis, the annual amount of such item shall be apportioned to each month on a days over days basis and allocated to the Classes for each such month in which each such item would be allocated for the applicable month under paragraphs 4(a) through 4(d). </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">h.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The Partnership does not intend to revalue, book up, or book down any assets, Class Accounts or Adjusted NAV Accounts in connection with any contributions to and distributions by the Partnership. </font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:72pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">i.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;The General Partner&#8217;s (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager&#8217;s) determination of allocations shall be binding upon all parties.  Nothing in this Section 4 is intended to affect distributions under the Onshore LPA.</font></div><div style="margin-bottom:9pt;padding-left:36pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:-18pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">5.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:120%;text-decoration:underline">Modifications to Allocations</font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">.  The General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager) may, in consultation with its tax advisors, make allocations and&#47;or distributions in a manner other than as described above, including disproportionate allocations of gain or loss and&#47;or disproportionate distributions to the extent required under applicable laws, rules and regulations, or deemed advisable or necessary by the General Partner (or, by delegation, the Investment Manager), in all cases in a manner determined to be consistent with each Unitholder&#8217;s interest in the Partnership as described in Section 4.08 of the Onshore LPA.</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit D-2</font></div></div></div><div id="i80e0f31fc0a942af8545b80281a09983_391"></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:72pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:justify"><font><br></font></div></div><div style="margin-bottom:12pt;text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:700;line-height:100%">Appendix A</font></div><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">&#91;***&#93;</font></div><div style="height:72pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:165%">Exhibit D-3</font></div></div></div><script type="text/javascript"  src="/rmZXw/w/x-/sYIL/t4dKqNVq/uN5k4kQXkrtLS8/QwpAMw/bwNEMn4c/JUo"></script></body></html>
